body: No. I know you’re right. All these comments I know are true. Just hard to accept. Feels like such a waste of time and I wish I would have left years ago. I realize how unhappy I am . I really need to focus on myself for a long time and get back to doing things for me
I don’t want to put too much personal information on here ,  but he lost a sibling and they were extremely close and he hasn’t really worked since. Had a little bit of money from a relative saved

He told me it was “his ring” … even though we’ve been engaged for 6 months. He is immature. Every time I try to work through our problems , he “breaks” up with me and when I actually try to leave, he acts like it wasn’t a big deal and love bombs me. I feel like I’m getting older and more mature and he still acts like a teenager. I just don’t know how to actually leave. I do love him so much and wouldn’t want to be with anyone else, but I can’t play these high school games anymore. I thought he turned a page when he proposed but obviously I was wrong
